newsitem.title: INDIA: ITC officials in custody until Nov 13, agency says.
newsitem.headline: ITC officials in custody until Nov 13, agency says.

text.p: India's Enforcement Directorate will hold in judicial custody until November 13 one director and three former executives of the Calcutta-based tobacco firm ITC Ltd, a senior directorate official said on Wednesday.
Enforcement officials arrested R.K. Kutty, chairman and director-in-charge of ITC's international business division, and three former executives earlier on Wednesday.
K.K. Kabirpanthi, deputy director of Enforcement Directorate (eastern region) told a news conference in Calcutta enforcement officials were still questioning Saurav Misra, the deputy chairman of ITC.
A finance ministry statement, received by Reuters in New Delhi, said enforcement directorate officials raided premises of the company in a "major pre-dawn operation".
It said officials also searched the residences of ITC directors in Calcutta, Delhi, Bombay and Hyderabad.
"This is the biggest ever case in the history of enforcement directorate," Kabirpanthi said.
He said enforcement officials had summoned former chairman K.L. Chugh to appear for questioning on November 1.
Chugh was forced to resign in December 1995 after ITC's single largest shareholder, U.K.'s B.A.T Industries Plc , said it had lost faith in his chairmanship.
B.A.T, which controls 31.67 percent in ITC Ltd, has two directors on the board of the Indian firm.
